whyCareReason: The Monday result that moved Italy to 7 points was against Turkiye. Belgium were in Paris.
teaser: Scamacca, Simsir, Calafiori, Pio Esposito. Italy are second, three points behind France.
story: Italy beat Turkiye 3-1 in Bologna on Monday 5 October. Gianluca Scamacca scored first. Aral Simsir equalised just after the hour. Riccardo Calafiori and Pio Esposito scored the other Italy goals. AFP notes Italy had already won 4-1 in Bursa the previous week. Italy have 7 points (2 wins, 1 draw, 1 loss, 8 goals for, 5 against). Turkiye have 0 points and a goal difference of -9. There is no Italy against Belgium fixture on 8 October.
stakes: Italy stay second. The next group games are next month.
rivalryAngle: France, not Belgium, are the side three points ahead.
